---
title: Release 6.02.004 installation and source record
---

::: {.callout-warning title="Release candidate"}
The source and documentation are prepared for NADABAS 6.02.004. The final
signed package, file sizes, and SHA-256 checksums must be inserted below and
verified before this release is published.
:::

## Release scope

Release 6.02.004 corrects the release identity and completes Indonesian
language support introduced in the preceding development builds. It includes:

- `InterfaceVersionUpdate.CURRENT_VERSION` set to `6.02.004`, which is also the
  version displayed by About;
- Indonesian language column 6 (`id`) for ribbon labels, forms, messages, and
  error messages, with English retained as the fallback;
- an Indonesian option in the language-selection form;
- Indonesian text for automatic and manual version-check notifications; and
- a corrected download-page reference using the declared `DOWNLOAD_URL`
  constant, preventing the VBA compile error caused by `DOWNLOAD_PAGE_URL`.

## Package manifest

| File | Purpose | Size (bytes) | SHA-256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| `NADABAS.6.02.004.zip` | User download containing both signed Office files | Pending final signing | Pending final signing |
| `NADABAS.xlam` | Excel add-in and source of the release VBA project | Pending final signing | Pending final signing |
| `NADABAS.6.02.004.xlsm` | Versioned installer opened by the user | Pending final signing | Pending final signing |

The ZIP must contain the two Office files at its root. A checksum proves byte
identity with the reviewed artifact; it does not establish publisher identity.
Excel must report a valid, trusted digital signature for both Office files.

## Required release checks

1. Confirm that `InterfaceVersionUpdate.CURRENT_VERSION` is `6.02.004` and that
   About displays the same version.
2. Compile both VBA projects with **Debug > Compile VBAProject** and confirm
   that no undefined variable or other compile error is reported.
3. Run the automated test suite, pre-commit checks, VBA security scan, and
   Quarto documentation render.
4. Select each of the four languages and open representative ribbon controls,
   forms, messages, and error messages. Confirm that Indonesian uses column 6
   and that placeholders such as `%1` are preserved.
5. Run the manual update check in Indonesian for current-version, newer-version,
   and network-failure paths. Confirm that selecting Yes opens `DOWNLOAD_URL`.
6. Perform a clean installation from `NADABAS.6.02.004.xlsm`, reopen Excel,
   verify the NADABAS ribbon, and open About.
7. Sign the final XLAM and XLSM, create the final ZIP, verify both signatures,
   and replace the pending manifest values above.

## Installation

1. Close every Excel window.
2. Download `NADABAS.6.02.004.zip` from the official NADABAS channel.
3. Verify the ZIP checksum recorded above.
4. Extract `NADABAS.xlam` and `NADABAS.6.02.004.xlsm` to the same folder.
5. Verify the publisher and signature status of both extracted Office files.
6. Open `NADABAS.6.02.004.xlsm` and follow its installation action.
7. Close and reopen Excel, verify that the NADABAS ribbon loads, and confirm
   that About displays version 6.02.004.

## Source and rollback

The exported files below `vba/` are the source of truth. The signed binaries
are release evidence and are not committed as editable source files. Editing a
signed Office file invalidates its signature; rebuilds must be tested and
signed again.

Rollback consists of reinstalling the previously verified release package.
Keep the previous signed package and its checksums available until 6.02.004 has
passed clean installation and representative application-level tests.
